python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

# Let's inspect Sofa and Plant 2 and Lamp in obs 31, 32, 33:
# Camera poses:
# obs 31: (-0.5, 3.3), heading 90 (+x)
# obs 32: (0.0, 3.3), heading 90 (+x)
# obs 33: (0.5, 3.3), heading 90 (+x)

img31 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0031.png')
img32 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0032.png')
img33 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0033.png')

# Plant 2 pot in obs 31, 32, 33:
for i, img in zip([31, 32, 33], [img31, img32, img33]):
    mask_pot = (img[:,:,2] > 100) & (img[:,:,1] > 40) & (img[:,:,1] < 90) & (img[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 350)
    ys, xs = np.where(mask_pot)
    if len(ys) > 0:
        d = 256 * 1.55 / (ys.max() - 255.5)
        print(f'obs {i} Plant 2: bottom y = {ys.max()}, center x = {xs.mean():.1f}, dist = {d:.2f}')

# Sofa back and armrest in obs 31, 32, 33:
# Grey color: [100..130, 95..125, 90..120]
for i, img in zip([31, 32, 33], [img31, img32, img33]):
    mask_sofa = (img[:,:,0] > 70) & (img[:,:,0] < 120) & (img[:,:,1] > 70) & (img[:,:,1] < 120) & (img[:,:,2] > 70) & (img[:,:,2] < 120) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 350)
    ys, xs = np.where(mask_sofa)
    if len(ys) > 0:
        print(f'obs {i} Sofa: bottom y = {ys.max()}, x in [{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], center x = {xs.mean():.1f}')
"
